verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is an AI video-generation tool, so a custom real-person avatar with a consent and verification flow is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only 2D stylized drawing engines and original or user-supplied character designs. There is no documented feature for building a real-person avatar and no consent or verification flow.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow
